summary: Title: Solana ETFs draw record $188 million in a week as Bitwise takes two-thirds of inflows URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/09/28/solana-etfs-draw-record-usd188-million-in-a-week-as-bitwise-takes-two-thirds-of-inflows Published Time: 2026-09-28T06:21:06.511Z Markdown Content: Sep 28, 2026, 2:21 a.m. EDT 2 min read ![Image 1: Solana ETFs' record week ran through one fund. (Shaurya Malwa/CoinDesk)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F1db0c2ba3d07244b16adedc9c3f8c810aab80cff-1402x780.png%3Frect%3D8%2C0%2C1387%2C780%26w%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) Solana ETFs' record week ran through one fund. (Shaurya Malwa/CoinDesk) Summary * U.S. spot Solana exchange-traded funds drew a record $188 million in net inflows last week, with every fund in the group attracting new money. * Bitwise’s BSOL led with about $128 million, or 68 percent of the weekly total, and has captured roughly $1.2 billion of the group’s $1.6 billion in cumulative inflows. * The record flows came as Solana developers tested Alpenglow, an upgrade intended to reduce payment finality from about 12.8 seconds to roughly 150 milliseconds. U.S. spot solana exchange-traded funds attracted a record $188 million last week, with Bitwise’s BSOL taking about two-thirds of the money as every fund in the group recorded inflows. BSOL brought in roughly $128 million during the five sessions through Sept. 25. Grayscale’s GSOL followed with $28 million and Fidelity’s FSOL with $18 million, according to weekly figures shared by Solana’s official account. Morgan Stanley, VanEck, Franklin Templeton and 21Shares accounted for the remaining $14 million. Friday supplied nearly half the weekly total. The funds added about $87 million that day — the [largest since going live](https://farside.co.uk/sol/) — including $56 million for Bitwise and $19 million for Grayscale. Spot ETFs let investors hold exposure to SOL

title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
summary: Title: ETH news: Ethereum may not be ‘just a blockchain’ in 2030, Vitalik Buterin says URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/09/27/vitalik-buterin-maps-ethereum-s-shift-beyond-a-blockchain-in-sweeping-2030-vision Published Time: 2026-09-27T14:29:13.450Z Markdown Content: Sep 27, 2026, 10:29 a.m. EDT 4 min read ![Image 1: Vitalik Buterin (CoinDesk Archives)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2Ffc25947f1bdd54e21669cfeb4f95b3a58f436d2c-1500x919.png%3Frect%3D0%2C38%2C1500%2C844%26w%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75) Vitalik Buterin (CoinDesk Archives) Summary * Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin envisions a 2030 network that uses cryptographic proofs and computers working off-chain to process more transactions without requiring every participant to repeat the same calculations. * The proposed system would let users independently verify results more efficiently while improving privacy for payments, balances and wallet activity. * Buterin said Ethereum’s transformation would accelerate after the planned Hegotá upgrade, though developers must still make proofs cheaper and coordinate parallel work securely. Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said Sunday that the network he envisions for 2030 may still be called a blockchain, but it would work very differently from today’s version. In a [post titled “The cryptographic world computer,”](https://vitalik.eth.limo/general/2026/09/27/the_cryptographic_world_computer.html) Buterin described a system combining a blockchain with cryptographic proofs and networks of computers working outside it. The plan through 2030 would change both how much Ethereum can do and what users can independently verify. Ethereum already lets people send money, trade tokens and borrow through applications that run according to shared rules. The difficulty is making those applications serve more people without making the network too expensive to use

Stablecoin issuer Tether said it has very little exposure to a lender seized by U.S. authorities on Thursday. summary: Title: Live updates: Bitcoin moves to $84,000, oil slides on latest report of Middle East progress URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/09/25/live-updates-bitcoin-steadies-near-usd84-000-as-the-bond-selloff-pauses Published Time: 2026-09-25T07:09:11.094Z Markdown Content: coverage ended Sep 25, 2026, 4:35 p.m. EDT Separate reports from Axios and CBS suggest some positive movement in U.S.-Iran negotiations. ![Image 1](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F0a0a8c9fc0feabeb7ee727063b2300aad6776bb8-2280x1284.png%3Fauto%3Dformat%26w%3D960%26h%3D540%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26fit%3Dclip%26q%3D75%26fm%3Djpg&w=3840&q=75) ![Image 2: Stephen Alpher](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F9c64385838f127845d0783e09a18548c2b886ce2-512x512.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## A gun firing backwards: Hedge funder Hugh Hendry says Fed's rate hike sets up rate cut “The Federal Reserve may have just raised interest rates in order to cut them,” [wrote Hugh Hendry on Friday](https://x.com/hendry_hugh). The iconoclast former hedge fund manager argued that “oil is the complication because it attacks from both directions." It raises the headline price level in a way that’s easy for all to see, while at the same time removing spending power from the economy. “The Warsh mandate makes [the rate hike] legitimate,” he continued. The result, however, “is a monetary brake applied on top of an energy tax, with both forces pressing on the same household.” The “gun fires backwards,” said Hendry, as the rate hike is aimed at inflation, but lands on demand that the higher oil price is already squeezing. “It bought Warsh permission to cut without appearing to be captured by the White House … The weapon aimed at inflation would have produced the conditions for lower rates, and the recoil becomes the policy.
